about: Hand-checked by Claude, 2026-10-13: 10 rows per language from sample_multilang.json (12 languages). 'wrong' = wrong for the lesson's sense, untranslated, corrupt, or the wrong part of speech. Leading articles and capitalisation are left to mechanical sweeps. European languages are judged confidently. Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Hindi judgements lean on dictionaries, so treat them as softer.
